title: Advice from home
instructions: Before Mila left Germany, her mum gave her a lot of advice. Now Mila tells Sofia about it. Write Mila's sentences. Use **told me** or **asked me** + (**not**) **to** + infinitive.
hint: Mila is talking: *you / your* in her mum's words → **me / my**.

items.direct: Mum: "Send us a message every day."
items.answer: My mum told me to send [them|her and my dad|my parents] a message every day.

items.direct: Mum: "Don't spend all your money in the first week."
items.answer: My mum told me not to spend all my money in the first week.

items.direct: Mum: "Help your host family in the house."
items.answer: My mum told me to help my host family in the house.
My mum told me not to stay up too late.
My mum told me to try lots of new things.

items.direct: Mum: "Please call Grandpa on his birthday."
items.answer: My mum asked me to call [Grandpa|my grandpa] on his birthday.
